conflicts.ce_equivalent: Must be manually implemented in ManimCE using a VGroup of Rectangles positioned next to each other via next_to(..., RIGHT, buff=0).
In ManimCE, dynamic resizing of Rectangles inside updaters requires recreating the Rectangle or using .become() to avoid cumulative scaling/distortion issues.
interpolate_color is available in both, but color hex strings and constant names (like BLUE_E, TEAL_E) must be verified for exact match.
